name: BART Summer Internship (high school)
what_you_do: Paid summer internship at BART, 10 to 20 hours a week, in person.
who_can_apply: At least 16 years old, and enrolled in high school or college (or enrolled within the past 12 months). A community group must sponsor your placement.
duration: June 22 to July 31, 2026, 10 to 20 hours a week
deadline_text: 2026 program ran June 22 to July 31, 2026. Direct applications are not accepted. 2027 not posted.
how_to_apply: You cannot apply to BART directly. Ask a community organization or your school to sponsor you and have them email workforcedevelopment@bart.gov.
notes: Sponsor organizations fund the placements. Build a relationship with a community group and ask them to contact workforcedevelopment@bart.gov.
